turnaround_reason: Charter collapsed ~65% from its ~$286 high on relentless broadband subscriber losses (fixed-wireless and fiber overbuild) and revenue in its fourth straight quarterly decline. Deep-value thesis is that the market is pricing terminal decline into a still-cash-gushing business that just gained scale via the $34.5B Cox close.
bullish_points: Extraordinarily cheap: trailing P/E ~3.95, fwd P/E ~3.44, P/B ~1.07 — pricing in secular death
Large FCF (~$2.2B TTM) plus a history of aggressive buybacks that shrink the share count fast at these multiples
Cox merger closed (largest US broadband/video provider, ~37M customers); synergy target raised to $800M from $500M
Mobile is the growth engine: ~12M lines and climbing; video-loss drag improving
Short interest is ~52% of float — any stabilization in broadband nets could force a violent squeeze
bearish_points: Core broadband is in secular decline: lost 172K internet subs in Q2 2026 (worse than Q1's 120K); revenue down ~1.7% YoY, fourth straight decline
Enormous leverage: total debt ~$96.7B, D/E 441, current ratio 0.36 — a classic 'equity is the residual' capital structure
Fixed wireless (T-Mobile/Verizon) and fiber overbuilders are structural, not cyclical, pressures
51% short float cuts both ways — it reflects deep institutional conviction that the equity compounds down, not up
catalyst: A quarter showing broadband net-adds stabilizing plus Cox synergy realization, which would break the terminal-decline narrative and trigger multiple re-rate / short-covering
suggested_trade: Starter spot $150-152 sized small given the leverage; this is a levered mean-reversion / de-rating-reversal bet, not a compounder. Consider defined-risk call spreads into the Oct print rather than naked longs.
key_risk: Broadband subscriber losses keep accelerating, confirming secular decline; with 441 D/E, persistent revenue erosion eventually threatens the equity regardless of how cheap the multiple looks.
would_skip_if: Q3 broadband net losses widen again vs Q2, or management signals synergy slippage / guides revenue lower.
